## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting passes
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Tests and coverage thresholds pass
- [ ] Library and demo build
- [ ] Package validation passes
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or personal data are included

## Compatibility and security

Describe API compatibility, migration requirements, and changes to authentication or data handling. Use private vulnerability reporting instead of a pull request for undisclosed security issues.
